tip: In the perfect, a perception verb like sehen stays an infinitive, not gesehen. So kommen sehen, two infinitives stacked, not kommen gesehen.
habe is Konjunktiv I, marking reported speech you do not vouch for. After Es heißt it flags hearsay: habe hergestellt, not hat.
lassen plus an infinitive means having something done for you: die Haare schneiden lassen = get your hair cut, not cut it yourself.
For a separable verb like mitbringen, the zu-infinitive puts zu between prefix and stem: mitzubringen, not zu mitbringen.
Since Zweifel goes with an, German previews the dass-clause with daran (da + an): kein Zweifel daran, dass.
Paired comparatives: je plus comparative sends the verb to the end (näherte), then desto plus comparative takes verb-second: desto heller.
